params.name: input
params.label: Input
params.description: The node whose surface is the cast; a shell is built inward from it with a thickness that follows its curvature.

params.name: maximum_thickness
params.label: Maximum Thickness
params.description: Shell thickness in world units where the surface is most concave, cupping inward, where a mold needs the most material.

params.name: minimum_thickness
params.label: Minimum Thickness
params.description: Shell thickness in world units where the surface is most convex, bulging outward.

params.name: remesh_division_size
params.label: Remesh Division Size
params.description: Edge length in world units the surface is remeshed to before thickening, which sets how finely the thickness can vary.

params.name: ramp
params.label: Ramp
params.description: How curvature maps to thickness between the minimum and maximum. Linear is proportional, Smooth eases at both ends, Constant uses the maximum everywhere.
